parameter.name: verificationConfigKey
parameter.description: Fallback only. The sender's public key store normally arrives as configKey on the stage.

parameter.name: mode
parameter.description: strict (default) holds the message until its signature has been checked. streaming serves as it goes, and is safe only where a failed run undoes everything below this stage.

parameter.name: maxPlaintextSize
parameter.description: Cap on the data held in strict mode, e.g. 50GB. Free space on the scratch volume is always enforced as well.

parameter.name: requireValidSignerKey
parameter.description: true (default) refuses a signature made with a revoked or expired key, even when the signature itself is valid.
